entries.for: Time the turn with the smoothed close fixture

entry.definition: Exponential moving average of a series, seeded with the simple mean of its first period values.
entry.boundaries: A smoothing of price; it says where the average is, not how strong a trend is.
entry.recognition: Price above a rising EMA reads as an uptrend, below a falling one as a downtrend.

sources.quote: a trend pullback on EURUSD and XAUUSD, M15, built only from blocks that wrap code QMX already runs (EMA, ROC, RSI, swing points)
